name: Aenean Frostlance deals 2 damage to target unit
notes: Aenean Frostlance's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water, reused from coriolis-ward-prevent-level/perfect-repulsion-prevent-x).
